decision.warm_precision_prototype.2026-1.description: Implement the requested reference-aligned component-based clickable prototype and reconcile its visual rules with DESIGN.md.
decision.warm_precision_prototype.2026-1.rationale: The user explicitly requested the prototype follow DESIGN.md and the first mockup with reusable components. This records the authored prototype/model update and its browser-only verification; it is not native application acceptance or a human readiness_review of every component. Previous revision-bound records remain archived.
